title: Can I BEAT Atomic Chess?
summary: Atomic chess: every capture explodes, removing the capturing piece, the captured piece and all non-pawn pieces in the surrounding 3x3. Exploding the enemy king wins. He goes for early blasts and learns the pawn exception.
rules: Captures cause an explosion: capturer, captured piece and all adjacent non-pawn pieces are removed.
Pawns adjacent to the blast are not removed (pawns only die if directly captured or capturing).
Win by exploding the enemy king; a king cannot capture; kings may touch.
Moves that explode your own king are illegal.
current_impl_issues: Base Atomic matches; ensure pawn exception (3:43).

current_impl.explain: Captures explode and destroy every non-pawn piece around them. Blow up the enemy king to win.
